key_concepts: Decantation separates a less-dense substance from a denser one by pouring off the liquid w
Evaporation separates a dissolved solid from a liquid by heating or exposing the mixture t
Filtration separates solid particles from a liquid using filter paper or cloth as a filter
Sieving separates bigger solid components from finer ones
A magnet can separate iron materials from other materials in a mixture
Picking is used to separate solid mixtures such as fruit salad or rice grains and stones
Sieving can separate rocks into different sized particles for construction
A strainer with small holes can separate cornstarch from small stones
Water and salt can be separated by evaporation
Sand and nails can be separated using a magnet
